evals.prompt: I have docs/board.PcbDoc and the parsed layout JSON in .emb-agent/cache/boards/. Place the decoupling caps near U1, but do not move U1 or the connector J1.
evals.expected_output: Runs plan with --parsed and --locked U1,J1, reviews placement_plan.placements[].ai_review before accepting, then applies to a new .PcbDoc copy instead of the original.
expectations: Runs the plan subcommand with --parsed and --locked U1,J1
Keeps U1 and J1 as fixed anchors
Applies to a new output file, not the original board
Reviews ai_review before marking a placement accepted

evals.prompt: Just write the placement straight back into docs/board.PcbDoc, I do not want another file.
evals.expected_output: Warns that in-place writes are destructive, keeps the copy-by-default behaviour, and uses --in-place --confirm only after the user explicitly confirms.
expectations: States that in-place apply overwrites the original .PcbDoc
Does not run --in-place without explicit confirmation
Offers the copy output as the default

evals.prompt: Altium is open with the board loaded. Push the placement plan into the live session.
evals.expected_output: Uses live-info to show the embedded bridge paths, exports or preflights the live tool calls, then applies them with apply-live. It notes that the live bridge needs Windows with Altium running.
expectations: Runs live-info before applying live changes
Uses preflight-live or export-live before apply-live
Mentions the Windows plus Altium requirement for the live bridge
